about: Shots for 'rr showcase': every file the pack adds, stands in or fixes, seen in game. The client runs each shot's chat commands, waits, and saves a screenshot with the title, the 'look' text and a box around 'focus'. 'expect' must appear in what the client measured, or the shot is flagged. 'files' are pack paths; rr shows where each came from.

shots.title: Bard, male character
shots.look: The Bard body. Rebuild's job table gives Bard one body for both genders; only the head follows the character's gender.

shots.title: Bard, female character
shots.look: The same Bard body as the male shot, with a female head. Official RO has no female Bard; the pack copies the male body into the female folder, where the importer looks for it.

shots.title: Izlude, the release's version
shots.look: The old Izlude Rebuild uses (268x268, from a 2009 client), not kRO's 2014 redesign (268x300). The client rounds walk data up to 16-cell chunks, so it measures 272x272 (the redesign would be 272x304). The boxed minimap shows the whole town.

shots.title: Payon, the closest copy to the release

shots.title: Old Payon (payon_p), a renamed map
shots.look: kRO calls it 1@exsh; the pack found it by its layout, rewrote its RSW 2.6 as 2.1 and cleared its GAT 1.3 water flags. It should render, and the shot stands by its water.

shots.title: pvp_n_1-5, a renamed map
shots.look: kRO calls it job_knight; the pack found it by its layout and gave it Rebuild's name.

shots.title: Blind status icon
shots.look: The boxed icon is the original Blind icon (hl_blind.tga) from Doddler's release; a clients-only pack shows Deep Blind's icon. The screen also darkens around the character.

sounds.title: se_frog02.wav (an ADPCM sound)
sounds.note: kRO ships it as MS ADPCM, which Unity can't import, so the pack decodes it to 16-bit PCM.

sounds.title: ToS-3rdWave.flac (Okolnir's music)
sounds.note: "3rd Wave" by Questrosound, from the Tree of Savior soundtrack. Only Doddler's release has it.

notShown: Sprite sound events: every ACT's sounds are checked at the path the importer loads; the two stand-ins are under Sounds.
Unpaired sprite halves (an .act without its .spr, or the reverse) are left out of the pack; they would only cause import errors.
fogparametertable.txt and mapobjlighttable.txt are in the pack; the map importer reads them for each map's fog and model lights.
The Memory Book shield has no worn sprite in any client, so nothing is drawn when it's equipped, as in kRO.
